expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /sign in|log in|submit/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'no button'; })()

(() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => (x.textContent || '').includes('Untitled workflowBrowser')); if (b) { b.click(); return 'opened'; } return 'not found'; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; return 'runStatus=' + (t.includes('failed') ? 'failed' : 'completed') + ' | okBadges=' + (t.match(/\bok\b/g) || []).length + ' | trailSteps=' + document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog], ol li').length; })()
